procedures.title: Corvette rear axle: general description
notes: (continued) ...next to the differential bearings, with a lip seal pressed in outboard of each bearing to keep oil in and dirt out.
The bolted carrier cover gives access to the internals. It has two reinforced mounting pads that attach the carrier to the suspension crossmember, plus a mounting point for the spring center section.
The filler plug is on the right side of the cover near the bolting flange.
The carrier can be removed for any service without taking off the cover; the cover only comes off when replacing the whole carrier housing, since carrier and cover are serviced as one assembly.
